inputs.52.text: Modern high-end Japanese anime game cinematic key visual, sharp digital illustration with crisp thin lineart, realistic adult proportions, dramatic cel shading with hard-edged shadows, strong rim light, glowing bloom light effects, deep saturated color and high contrast. A Civil War night seen from a hill: on the near left bank rows of white Union army tents with blue flags and campfires, a dark river running through the middle, on the far right bank rows of grey Confederate army tents with campfires, smoke drifting under a starry sky, wide panoramic establishing view of the place standing empty and still.
